text:
liz: Heads-up — I'm drafting an autofallback UX for rollouts. Need quick ops + console input before I wire telemetry. Main concerns: how do we surface degrade modes, what triggers should be configurable, and what goes in the audit trail? Trying to keep the root UX lightweight.

matt: +1. Two quick asks: 1) preview/simulate before enabling; 2) make reason codes explicit in traces (so SRE can filter by 'rate_limit' vs 'model_regression').

priya: Agree. Also quotas and SLA visibility per-route are non-negotiable. We can't let a silent fallback mask quota exhaustion. Ops should be able to require an operator confirmation for silent mode in prod. :lock:

sam: For triggers, can we separate infra errors (timeouts/5xx), throttling (429s), and quality regressions (eval fail)? I propose booleans like: fallback_on_timeout, fallback_on_rate_limit, fallback_on_model_quality.

matt: Sketch of a compact policy shape (POC):

```json
{
  "policy_id": "autofb-2026-01",
  "mode": "soft", // soft | silent | force
  "triggers": {
    "timeout_ms": 3000,
    "fallback_on_5xx": true,
    "fallback_on_429": true,
    "fallback_on_quality_drop": true
  },
  "operator_confirm_required": true,
  "simulation_sample_pct": 1
}
```

devops-bot: staging:policy-check passed for branch liz/autofallback-proto — lint=ok, tests=12/12 :white_check_mark:

liz: Nice. A few more audit items: store policy_id, decision_ts, source_signal_snapshot, operator_override_id. For compliance we need input hashes (salted) rather than raw payloads.

priya: Telemetry breadcrumbs idea: decision_ts, signal_snapshot, policy_version, route_id, downstream_error_code, simulated_flag. That lets us rebuild "why" for a fallback decision.

sam: Add replay_id so the eval harness can replay the exact in-flight inputs (without raw text) to check regressions.

matt: For the console UX: toggles for modes: [soft] [silent] [force], plus a "simulate" button that runs X sampled requests and returns projected RPS/latency delta. Endpoint I mocked: `POST /internal/policies/:id/simulate?sample=1000` returning metrics.

liz: Perfect. I'll update the prototype and ping @design for microcopy and @legal for hashed retention policy. I'll also add a short runbook snippet for operators explaining implications of each mode.

matt: I'll prototype the simulate response and wire it to our sandbox. tagging @sam for replay_id interface.

priya: We should also add a visible badge in route dashboard when autofallback is enabled (so product teams aren't surprised). :eyes:

liz: Agreed. OK team — I'll convert this into a tiny RFC and drop the prototype link here tomorrow. Thanks everyone.

matt: Thanks — excited to see the prototype.

devops-bot: deployed prototype to sandbox at https://sandbox.redwood.internal/autofb/proto (branch: liz/autofallback-proto)
